cards.text:
V-TD06/001EN
Great Composure Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Narukami｜ Grade 3｜ Power 12000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](VC/RC):At the beginning of your or your opponent's battle phase, this unit gets [Power] +3000 until end of turn for each open (RC) in your opponent's front row. If it is your turn, it gets [Power] +5000 instead of +3000.

V-TD06/002EN
Duress Clap Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Narukami｜ Grade 3｜ Power 12000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](RC):When placed, choose up to one of your opponent's rear-guards, move it to another open (RC) in the same column as that unit, and this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn.

V-TD06/003EN
Thunderstorm Dragoon
Normal Unit｜ Narukami｜ Grade 2｜ Power 9000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](RC):During your turn, if your opponent's front row has one or less rear-guards, this unit gets [Power] +5000.

V-TD06/004EN
Recklessness Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Narukami｜ Grade 2｜ Power 9000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], choose a rear-guard in your opponent's front row, and bind it.
[AUTO](RC):When it attacks a vanguard, if your opponent's front row has one or less rear-guards, this unit gets [Power] +3000 until end of that battle.

V-TD06/005EN
Excess Streak Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Narukami｜ Grade 2｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):When placed, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], choose a rear-guard in your opponent's front row, and bind it. If you bound a card, this unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn.

V-TD06/006EN
Red River Dragoon

V-TD06/007EN
Photon Bomber Wyvern
Normal Unit｜ Narukami｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[ACT](RC):[COST][Counter-Blast 2], and this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn. If your opponent's front row has one or less rear-guards, it gets [Power] +10000 instead of +5000.

V-TD06/008EN
Lizard Soldier, Riki
Normal Unit｜ Narukami｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed, [COST][Soul-Blast 1], and this unit gets [Power] +3000 until end of turn. You may switch all of your opponent's rear-guards between the front and the back rows. (They all move simultaneously. The center column does not move)

V-TD06/009EN
Lizard Soldier, Ouho
Normal Unit｜ Narukami｜ Grade 1｜ Power 7000｜ Shield 0
[CONT]:Sentinel (You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck.)
[AUTO](GC):When placed, [COST][discard a card from your hand], and one of your units cannot be hit until end of that battle.
